title: Lesson 14: Event Sourcing & CQRS — js-tools
desc: A real event store on PostgreSQL with 200,000 events: a non-idempotent projection run a second time produces a balance exactly 2.00 times too high with no warning at all; replaying the entire read model in application code takes 235 ms, so fixing a bug and rebuilding is a business-hours job; a snapshot is 6.6 times faster with a 100,000-event aggregate but SLOWER by 2.6 times with a 200-event aggregate; and UNIQUE(aggregate, version) blocks lost updates without any distributed lock at all.
